surface_mechanism_description: The growth of ZrO2 started with the formation of the cubic polymorph and continued with the formation of the tetragonal polymorph. The ratio between the lattice parameters increased with the film thickness and growth temperature.
evidence: At 272 and 325 8C, the growth of ZrO2 started with the formation of the cubic polymorph and continued with the formation of the tetragonal polymorph. The ratio between the lattice parameters increased with the film thickness and growth temperature. The concentration of residual iodine impurities decreased toward higher deposition temperatures, being 1.2, 0.9 and 0.8 at.% in the films grown at 272–275, 325 and 350 8C, respectively.
